description: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate 3.0.1: 2.0->3.0 cardinality and datatype flips, renamed idShorts, IEC CDD/ECLASS version pairing, Markings/AddressInformation rules, PDF-vs-template-JSON IRDI discrepancy.

items.question: We are moving our Digital Nameplate to IDTA 02006 version 3.0.1. What submodel semanticId must the Nameplate submodel carry?
items.expected_answer: https://admin-shell.io/idta/nameplate/3/0/Nameplate - the bug-fix release 3.0.1 keeps the 3/0 IRI; there is no 3/0/1 IRI.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment

items.question: Our 2.0-era checklist marks YearOfConstruction as mandatory. Is YearOfConstruction mandatory in Digital Nameplate 3.0/3.0.1?
items.expected_answer: No. Since 3.0 YearOfConstruction is optional [0..1]; it was mandatory [1] in 2.0.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment

items.question: Is OrderCodeOfManufacturer optional in the 3.0.1 Digital Nameplate, as it was in 2.0?
items.expected_answer: No. Since 3.0 OrderCodeOfManufacturer is mandatory (cardinality 1); in 2.0 it was optional [0..1].

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment

items.question: When migrating a 2.0 nameplate to 3.0.1, can HardwareVersion, FirmwareVersion and SoftwareVersion stay MultiLanguageProperty elements?
items.expected_answer: No. In 3.0 they are Properties with valueType xs:string; the langString (MLP) type belonged to 2.0.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Annex B, data type changes table (DataType V 2.0 / V 3.0)
citation.quote: HardwareVersion langString String FirmwareVersion langString String SoftwareVersion langString String

items.question: Which valueType does URIOfTheProduct have in Digital Nameplate 3.0.1?
items.expected_answer: xs:anyURI (AnyUri); in 2.0 it was a plain String.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Annex B, data type changes table

items.question: A 2.0 nameplate has an SMC called ContactInformation. What is it called in 3.0.1 and where does its content come from?
items.expected_answer: It was renamed AddressInformation and is defined by the SMT drop-in "Address Information".

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.quote: SMC "ContactInformation" was renamed to "AddressInformation" and is now defined by a drop-in from SMT drop-in "Address Information"

items.question: Which elements must be present inside AddressInformation of a 3.0.1 Digital Nameplate, given that the drop-in itself defines all address properties as optional?
items.expected_answer: Street, Zipcode, CityTown and NationalCode (all MLPs) shall be specified; this requirement is stated in the document only, not in the AASX.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.quote: The following SubmodelElements shall be specified within SMC AddressInformation: • MLP Street • MLP Zipcode • MLP CityTown • MLP NationalCode

items.question: An auditor flags the AddressInformation SMC in our idta/nameplate/3/0 submodel because its semanticId is in the zvei/nameplate/1/0 namespace. Is that a version-pairing error?
items.expected_answer: No. The 3.0.1 table itself gives AddressInformation the primary semanticId https://admin-shell.io/zvei/nameplate/1/0/ContactInformations/AddressInformation (plus smt-dropin-use, IEC CDD and ECLASS supplementals).

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment

items.question: What ECLASS supplementalSemanticId does FirmwareVersion carry in Digital Nameplate 3.0.1?
items.expected_answer: 0173-1#02-AAM985#004 (the PDF prints it as 0173-1#02AAM985#004 because the hyphen is lost at a line break); this IRDI was corrected by 3.0.1 bug fix #123.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment

items.notes: The IDTA 02006 3.0 PDF gave FirmwareVersion 0173-1#02-AAN270#004 (HardwareVersion's IRDI); 3.0.1 bug fix #123.

items.question: The 3.0.1 PDF prints the same ECLASS supplementalSemanticId (AAM985#004) for FirmwareVersion and SoftwareVersion. Which supplementalSemanticId does the official 3.0.1 template file give SoftwareVersion?
items.expected_answer: The official 3.0.1 template JSON gives SoftwareVersion 0173-1#02-AAM737#004 (ECLASS software version); the AAM985#004 in the PDF row is a print error (that is FirmwareVersion's IRDI).

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment - official template JSON

items.notes: PDF (bundled txt page 10) prints 'SoftwareVersion 0112/2///61987#ABA601#008 supplementalSemanticId: 0173-1#02-AAM985#004'. Annex A says the AASX template file is definitive.

items.question: In Digital Nameplate 3.0.1, is Markings an SMC holding Marking collections? Give the list attributes.
items.expected_answer: No. Markings is a SubmodelElementList (changed from SMC in 3.0) with orderRelevant=No and typeValueListElement=SubmodelElementCollection; each item SMC holds MarkingName and MarkingFile (mandatory).

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: 3.3 Properties of the SML "Markings", element details

items.question: How should the CE marking be expressed in MarkingName of a 3.0.1 nameplate, and may we use the ECLASS boolean 'CE-qualification present'?
items.expected_answer: Preferably as a valueId IRDI from the IEC CDD/ECLASS enumeration: CE = 0112/2///61987#ABO409#003 or 0173-1#07-DAA603#004 (plain text in value is the fallback). The boolean 0173-1#02-BAF053#008 should not be used; use the enumeration value instead.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.quote: the preferable solution is to provide a valueId in IRDI originating from IEC CDD or ECLASS enumeration value list

items.question: Where do GuidelineSpecificProperties go in a 3.0.1 nameplate - directly under the submodel?
items.expected_answer: No. They are nested under AssetSpecificProperties: one GuidelineSpecificProperties entry per additional standard, all placed under the parent node AssetSpecificProperties.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.quote: all SMC "GuidelineSpecificProperties" should be placed under the parent node "AssetSpecificProperties"

items.question: The official 3.0.1 Nameplate AASX gives idShorts to the items of the Markings list. Is that valid under metamodel 3.0?
items.expected_answer: No - under metamodel 3.0 (AASd-120) SML items must not carry an idShort; the spec's Known issues state the AASX will be valid as of metamodel V3.1, which allows idShort for SMEs inside an SML.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.quote: Aasx file will be valid as of metamodel V3.1. V3.1 will allow to add idShort for SME within a SML

items.notes: AASd-120 is in aas-core-meta-v3_0.py lines 2668-2669 and absent from v3_1/v3_2.

items.question: Which property was added to the Nameplate root in 3.0 in anticipation of the EU ESPR, and is it mandatory?

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.quote: Property "UniqueFacilityIdentifier" was added to the structure of the Submodel Nameplate (in anticipation of the requirements of the European ESPR Regulation)
